PCtrl.Label: Import CSV file
PCtrl.ToolTip: Reads a CSV/TXT file with a header line into the grid

PCtrl.Label: Import JSON file
PCtrl.ToolTip: Reads a JSON array (or an object with exactly one array) into the grid

PCtrl.Label: Import CliXML file
PCtrl.ToolTip: Reads a file written by Export-Clixml (or ...to CliXML)

PCtrl.Label: Import clipboard
PCtrl.ToolTip: Table from the clipboard: Markdown pipe table, tab separated (Excel), CSV or JSON; the format is detected automatically

PCtrl.Label: REST query (JSON)
PCtrl.ToolTip: Calls a URL and shows the JSON result as a table (array, or an object with one array)

PCtrl.Label: SQL query
PCtrl.ToolTip: Runs a SELECT query via System.Data.SqlClient (SQL Server; the connection string is remembered)

PCtrl.Label: Folder contents
PCtrl.ToolTip: Lists the files and folders of a directory (optionally recursive, with a filter)

PCtrl.Label: Open (Explorer)
PCtrl.ToolTip: Opens the selected file or folder with its default program
